title: Aurora 超級電腦架構
subcategoryTitle: 高效能運算與世界級超算
summary: 以Aurora 的 Xeon Max、Ponte Vecchio 與資料路徑串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect aurora xeon max, ponte vecchio and data paths with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

stages.title: 系統與節點
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「系統與節點」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop systems and nodes through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 異質節點：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「異質節點」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for heterogeneous nodes.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「異質節點」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：Aurora 計算節點結合兩 Xeon Max 與六 GPU Max。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for heterogeneous nodes. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Aurora combines two Xeon Max CPUs with six GPU Max devices per compute node. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw original CPU/GPU functional blocks. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw original CPU/GPU functional blocks. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Aurora 是隻有 GPU 無 CPU 的系統。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Aurora contains GPUs without CPUs. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「異質節點」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for heterogeneous nodes; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: Aurora 計算節點結合兩 Xeon Max 與六 GPU Max。
knowledge.textEn: Aurora combines two Xeon Max CPUs with six GPU Max devices per compute node.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Draw original CPU/GPU functional blocks. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 公開架構有每節點 6 GPU；假想 1024³ FP64 陣列為 8 GiB，若每 GPU 存同樣輸入加兩個輸出共 24 GiB，則六份複製需 144 GiB，分佈分塊未必需六份輸入。例子是容量模型，非 Aurora 實際應用。
knowledge.textEn: Public architecture has six GPUs per node. A synthetic 1024-cubed FP64 array is 8 GiB; input plus two output arrays uses 24 GiB/GPU, or 144 GiB for six replicas. Partitioning may avoid replicated inputs; this is a capacity model, not an Aurora application.

quiz.question: 審查「異質節點」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for heterogeneous nodes?
options: Aurora 計算節點結合兩 Xeon Max 與六 GPU Max。
Aurora 是隻有 GPU 無 CPU 的系統。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「異質節點」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Aurora combines two Xeon Max CPUs with six GPU Max devices per compute node.
Aurora contains GPUs without CPUs.
One matching output proves heterogeneous nodes for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: Aurora 計算節點結合兩 Xeon Max 與六 GPU Max。 重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。 因此「Aurora 是隻有 GPU 無 CPU 的系統。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Aurora combines two Xeon Max CPUs with six GPU Max devices per compute node. Draw original CPU/GPU functional blocks. The alternative "Aurora contains GPUs without CPUs." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 異質節點：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「異質節點」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for heterogeneous nodes.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。」；將結果與「Aurora 計算節點結合兩 Xeon Max 與六 GPU Max。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Draw original CPU/GPU functional blocks. Compare results against: Aurora combines two Xeon Max CPUs with six GPU Max devices per compute node. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw original CPU/GPU functional blocks. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Aurora 是隻有 GPU 無 CPU 的系統。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Aurora contains GPUs without CPUs. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「異質節點」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「Aurora 是隻有 GPU 無 CPU 的系統。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for heterogeneous nodes; explain why this claim fails: Aurora contains GPUs without CPUs.

steps.title: CPU HBM：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「CPU HBM」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for cpu hbm.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for cpu hbm. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: CPU HBM and DDR can have distinct usage modes. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Separate fast and large-capacity regions on toy maps. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 在玩具分配圖區分高速與大容量區域。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Separate fast and large-capacity regions on toy maps. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：CPU HBM 與 DDR 必然有相同延遲與頻寬。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: CPU HBM and DDR have equal latency and bandwidth. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「CPU HBM」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「在玩具分配圖區分高速與大容量區域。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for cpu hbm; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「按公開功能層次畫原創示意。」；將結果與「Ponte Vecchio 的 tile、slice 與 Xe core 有層次。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Draw an original functional hierarchy from public descriptions. Compare results against: Ponte Vecchio tiles, slices and Xe cores form a hierarchy. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 按公開功能層次畫原創示意。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw an original functional hierarchy from public descriptions. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有 GPU 單元都只叫一個不可分割核心。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All GPU units form one indivisible core. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「GPU 層次」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「所有 GPU 單元都只叫一個不可分割核心。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for gpu hierarchy; explain why this claim fails: All GPU units form one indivisible core.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: Ponte Vecchio 的 tile、slice 與 Xe core 有層次。
knowledge.textEn: Ponte Vecchio tiles, slices and Xe cores form a hierarchy.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 按公開功能層次畫原創示意。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Draw an original functional hierarchy from public descriptions. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「GPU 層次」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for gpu hierarchy?
options: 所有 GPU 單元都只叫一個不可分割核心。
先把「GPU 層次」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
按公開功能層次畫原創示意。
optionsEn: All GPU units form one indivisible core.
Tune the displayed gpu hierarchy result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
Draw an original functional hierarchy from public descriptions.
quiz.explanation: Ponte Vecchio 的 tile、slice 與 Xe core 有層次。 按公開功能層次畫原創示意。 因此「所有 GPU 單元都只叫一個不可分割核心。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Ponte Vecchio tiles, slices and Xe cores form a hierarchy. Draw an original functional hierarchy from public descriptions. The alternative "All GPU units form one indivisible core." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 向量與矩陣：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Vectors and matrices: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「向量與矩陣」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for vectors and matrices.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「向量與矩陣」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：向量引擎與矩陣引擎適用不同運算。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「分類玩具 stencil 與 dense GEMM。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for vectors and matrices. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Vector and matrix engines suit different computations. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Classify toy stencils and dense GEMM. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 分類玩具 stencil 與 dense GEMM。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Classify toy stencils and dense GEMM. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：矩陣峰值就是任何向量運算吞吐。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Matrix peaks equal all vector throughput. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「向量與矩陣」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「分類玩具 stencil 與 dense GEMM。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for vectors and matrices; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 向量引擎與矩陣引擎適用不同運算。
knowledge.textEn: Vector and matrix engines suit different computations.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 分類玩具 stencil 與 dense GEMM。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Classify toy stencils and dense GEMM. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「向量與矩陣」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for vectors and matrices?
options: 向量引擎與矩陣引擎適用不同運算。
矩陣峰值就是任何向量運算吞吐。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「向量與矩陣」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Vector and matrix engines suit different computations.
Matrix peaks equal all vector throughput.
One matching output proves vectors and matrices for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 向量引擎與矩陣引擎適用不同運算。 分類玩具 stencil 與 dense GEMM。 因此「矩陣峰值就是任何向量運算吞吐。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Vector and matrix engines suit different computations. Classify toy stencils and dense GEMM. The alternative "Matrix peaks equal all vector throughput." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.
